weaponTypes.name: Pistol
weaponTypes.description: Sidearm-class weapons; fast swap, moderate damage, common as a backup slot.

weaponTypes.name: Submachine Gun (SMG)
weaponTypes.description: High fire-rate, close-range weapons with fast reloads.

weaponTypes.name: Assault Rifle
weaponTypes.description: Balanced mid-range weapons, the most versatile weapon class.

weaponTypes.name: Shotgun
weaponTypes.description: Multi-pellet, high burst-damage weapons for close range.

weaponTypes.name: Sniper Rifle
weaponTypes.description: High single-shot damage, long range, weakspot-focused.

weaponTypes.name: Light Machine Gun (LMG)
weaponTypes.description: Large magazines and sustained fire, pairs well with Fast Gunner effect.

weaponTypes.name: Bow / Crossbow
weaponTypes.description: Silent, high per-shot damage ranged weapons, often crit-focused.

weaponTypes.name: Heavy Weapon
weaponTypes.description: Grenade launchers, gatling guns and other explosive/AoE weapons.

weaponTypes.name: Melee Weapon
weaponTypes.description: Close-quarters weapons such as batons, blades and hammers.

weapons.name: Compound Bow
weapons.notes: Top-tier PvE burst weapon; excellent weakspot/crit damage, silent shots. Obtained from world weapon crates.

weapons.name: KVD — Boom! Boom!
weapons.notes: Legendary LMG variant; sustained explosive-leaning damage, considered a top pick alongside Compound Bow.

weapons.name: AWS.338 — Bingo
weapons.notes: Legendary sniper rifle, very high per-shot damage for weakspot hunting.

weapons.name: KAM — Abyss Glance
weapons.notes: Legendary assault rifle, balanced damage and fire rate.

weapons.name: DB12 — Raining Cash
weapons.notes: Legendary shotgun, strong burst close-range damage.

weapons.name: KV-SBR — Little Jaws
weapons.notes: Legendary SMG with very high fire rate for close-range fights.

weapons.name: MGL
weapons.notes: Grenade launcher, strong against grouped enemies and structures.

weapons.name: Stun Baton
weapons.notes: Melee option with crowd-control utility via stun.

weapons.name: MG4 — Predator
weapons.notes: Signature weapon for Fast Gunner builds; large magazine lets players fire roughly 200 rounds before reloading when built around the Fast Gunner weapon effect.

weapons.name: SN700 — Finale
weapons.notes: Reverb-stacking legendary sniper; rebalanced in patch 3.0.2 (reverb stacks reduced to 4, damage scaling adjusted).

note: Once Human's full arsenal spans 126+ weapons across these 9 categories (per oncehumandb.com). The list above covers the current top-tier / legendary picks and community tier-list standouts rather than the full catalog.
